description: Introducing the Hyper Bicycles 16" Jet Fuel BMX Bike for Kids, complete with training wheels. This bike is perfect for young riders who are just starting to learn how to ride. Featuring a custom Jet Fuel paint, it offers a unique and eye-catching design. The bike is equipped with training wheels, providing stability and support for young riders as they develop their balance and coordination skills. The durable steel frame ensures long-lasting durability, so your child can enjoy this bike for years to come. The front caliper and rear coaster brake allows for easy stopping and promotes safety during rides. The multi-surface 16-inch tires provide excellent traction on various terrains, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride for your child. Please note that adult assembly is required to ensure the bike is properly set up and secure for your child's safety. Let your child embark on exciting adventures with the Hyper Bicycles 16" Jet Fuel BMX Bike. With its stylish design, training wheels, and reliable construction, it's the perfect choice for young riders to develop their skills and enjoy the joy of cycling.

components.description: Front caliper and rear coaster brake
